object.description: Give an object a table and a figure, commit, and compare with the commit before. Expected: the details show the table at To and '(no table)' at From, and the figure at To and '(no figure)' at From. Change a table cell and replace the figure: both versions of each are shown. Remove the figure: the figure at From and '(no figure)' at To.
